question: I love seeing Nami in a kimono but I'd rather see her without her kimono. Nobuo
answer: I understand! She would say "Oh~my~♡" as you unravel her Obi! This is a common scene in historical plays so I actually wanted to include a scene of this as well. It ended up being too difficult to integrate it in without the story becoming too messy so I sincerely apologize to everyone!! As a mangaka I have the power to bring to life the dreams of my readers and I will continue to polish my skills to that end!! Ha!! Nononono!! That was something Sanada would say! SBS, that's all our time! See you in next volume!!
name: Captain Nobuo
credits: Translated by calmdownrelax. Translations may have been modified since the original versions.
